issues.description: REST endpoint base path for person resources is inconsistent: The problem statement (and the client controller implementation) specify and use the path '/persons' for person CRUD endpoints, but the server implementation in PersonResource exposes the endpoints under '/people'. Specifically, the client sends requests to '/persons' (e.g. POST /persons, GET /persons, PUT /persons/{id}, DELETE /persons/{id}) while the server defines mappings such as @GetMapping("people"), @PostMapping("people"), @PutMapping("people/{personId}"), @DeleteMapping("people/{personId}"). This naming mismatch prevents the client from reaching the server and contradicts the API described in the problem statement, blocking students from integrating client and server.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the person resource path consistent across artifacts. Recommended: update the server-side PersonResource mappings to use 'persons' (e.g. @GetMapping("persons"), @PostMapping("persons"), @PutMapping("persons/{personId}"), @DeleteMapping("persons/{personId}")) so they match the problem statement and the client controller. Alternatively, if 'people' is preferred, update the problem statement and all client-side URIs to use 'people' — but ensure all three (problem statement, client controller, server resource) use the same path.

issues.description: The REST resource path for the Person entity is inconsistent across artifacts: the Problem Statement and the client-side controller expect the endpoint path "/persons" (Problem Statement: lists POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /persons), the template server class PersonResource is left as a TODO (no mappings implemented yet), but the provided server solution implements the endpoints under "/people" (e.g., @GetMapping("people"), @PostMapping("people"), etc.). A student following the problem description or the client implementation (which issues requests to "persons") will not match the server solution's "people" mappings, causing requests to not be handled and leading to runtime failures and confusion about which path to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person endpoint path consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the server-side PersonResource mappings from "people" to "persons" (update @GetMapping("people"), @PostMapping("people"), @PutMapping("people/{personId}"), @DeleteMapping("people/{personId}") to use "persons" and "persons/{personId}")). This aligns the server with the Problem Statement and client controller. Alternatively, if you intentionally want "people", update the Problem Statement and the client controller to use "people" — but keep all three artifacts consistent.
